confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Jaipur prices, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain; cocktail and wine were set from general knowledge of Indian bar pricing and checked for a plausible ratio to the beer anchor. Accommodation is priced for July, which is monsoon off-season in Jaipur, so rates are lower than peak-season (October to March) rates and carry wider uncertainty. The FX observation comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page and was not independently verified on that page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is North Indian tourist cities with similar price levels and hotel stock, such as Agra and Udaipur, adjusted for Jaipur's Pink City visitor areas and for July off-season demand.
